conclusion: Human and LLM show similar cross-language divergence magnitude (human LDS-C margins +0.009, LLM +0.083). The human between-subject signal/floor ratio is 1.010 (~1.0 => signal submerged by within-group heterogeneity), while the LLM within-subject ratio is 1.096 (clearly below 1.0 => signal visible). The human null is a design artifact (between-subject heterogeneity inflates the floor to the signal level), NOT absence of a language effect.
